myth frame

  • CURIE: gmeow:mythFrame
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/mythFrame
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/narrative

The narrative reference frame under which in-myth claims hold true. Functional: one frame per Myth. In-myth claims are scoped accordingTo this frame.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Myth -> gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:mythFrame from gmeow:Myth to gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Myth, gmeow:NarrativeReferenceFrame
